what: A pausable gate that aborted at its first pause, kept as evidence: cldfrc_fice was to be answered by the original at the cloud stage's own transcribed call site, but the runner's frame entry refused the pause.
runner: pycam_stage7 (first module revision with the cldfrc_fice pause)
outcome: aborted at the first cloud_macro_microphysics call on all 512 ranks; the pause was reached, the frame was refused
error: NativeCAMError: pycam_stage7 runner has no frame (2): stage 7 is not paused; there is no frame
diagnosis: A generator defect, not a numerical failure: the module's advance machine paused at pc_at_fice and reported the pause, but pycam_stage7_frame_v1's pause guard still accepted only pc_at_pcond and pc_at_mg, so decoding the frame returned 'not paused'.  The resume and original_v1 guards already accepted the fice pause; only the frame guard was missed.  The single history file the aborted run had written compared bit-for-bit; the restart files were never written.
disposition: The generator's frame guard now accepts pc_at_fice (one line in the emitted module); rebuild the image and resubmit the gate.
